text:
Tree-cover loss was detected on the property in 2023, but the evidence does not establish whether the forest was cleared or the land use changed.

The mapped loss covered about **0.7 hectares**, or **1.2%** of the 58.1-hectare property. The 2021 national forest map classified 0.4 hectares of the affected area as planted eucalyptus forest and 0.3 hectares as outside mapped forest; none was mapped as native forest.

Tree-cover loss can result from plantation harvesting or other causes, so it should not be treated as proof of deforestation.
